findings.title: Title or description is about a different product

evidence.observed: 5 of 47 checked pages: /total/sponsoring-conferences-events-global-azure-bootcamp-2017-kuala-lumpur/ H1: 'Sponsoring Conferences and Events: Global Azure Bootcamp 2017 - Kuala Lumpur' → 'Delete messages from PST file permanently using .NET'; /words/aspose-words-for-net-5-3-0-released/ title: 'In-Browser Editor for Word Documents | Aspose.Editor' → 'Aspose.Words for .NET 5.3.0 Released'; /total/enhanced-presentation-access-and-rendering-support-provided-in-aspose.slides-for-.net/ title: 'Field Engine Progress in Aspose.Words 11.7 | Word API' → 'Enhanced presentation access and rendering support in Aspose.Slides for .NET'; /total/enhanced-presentation-access-and-rendering-support-provided-in-aspose.slides-for-.net/ meta description: 'We have just released Aspose.Words for .NET and Java 11.7. This month’s release includes almost 200 improvements to many areas of our components.' → 'We have just released Aspose.Slides for .NET 6.6. This release includes many improvements to presentation handling and rendering.'; /imaging/support-setting-gray-scale-psd-image-aspose.imaging-.net-17.7/ meta description: 'Use .NET Image Processing API to set the gray scale PSD image programmatically using Java within Spring or other Java based applications.' → 'Use .NET Image Processing API to set the gray scale for a PSD image programmatically using C#.'; and 2 more
evidence.expected: Title and meta description describe the page's own product, like its H1

locations.note: H1: 'Sponsoring Conferences and Events: Global Azure Bootcamp 2017 - Kuala Lumpur' → 'Delete messages from PST file permanently using .NET'
title: 'In-Browser Editor for Word Documents | Aspose.Editor' → 'Aspose.Words for .NET 5.3.0 Released'
title: 'Field Engine Progress in Aspose.Words 11.7 | Word API' → 'Enhanced presentation access and rendering support in Aspose.Slides for .NET'

meta description: 'We have just released Aspose.Words for .NET and Java 11.7. This month’s release includes almost 200 improvements to many areas of our components.' → 'We have just released Aspose.Slides for .NET 6.6. This release includes many improvements to presentation handling and rendering.'

meta description: 'Use .NET Image Processing API to set the gray scale PSD image programmatically using Java within Spring or other Java based applications.' → 'Use .NET Image Processing API to set the gray scale for a PSD image programmatically using C#.'
title: 'Add or Remove Comment Reply in Word in Java | Java Word API' → 'Aspose sponsors the vJUG24 Java Conference'

meta description: 'Add or remove comment reply from Word document in Java. Set base document for Word document comparison in Java. Compare Word Docs in Java. Java Word API.' → 'Aspose sponsors the vJUG24 Java Conference, bringing together Java developers to share knowledge and experience.'
